prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one independent transparent RGBA game HUD status/resource icon, designed to remain legible at native 32x32 pixels.
Primary request: create a completely redrawn chunky matte Empire C02 sci-fi status icon using Image 1 solely as the exact identity/composition reference and Image 2 solely as the already approved style/material reference. Do not copy Image 1's old glossy/noisy finish or its opaque background. Do not copy Image 2's tool subject.
Subject and invariant counts: Rebuild the verified permission status motif: one single chunky silver mechanical key on the left, slanting down-left, and one dark rectangular beveled access fob hanging to the right, joined by ONE large blue-gray loop ring above. Preserve the key's large round head with one concentric cyan inset and a short toothed blade. Preserve the fob's unique front mark: ONE thick amber outlined hexagon surrounding ONE smaller solid amber hexagon, with no letters. The tall fob has a slate-charcoal face, a broad blue lower/left rim, and amber top/right rim accents. Key blade, key head, large ring and fob must read separately at 32px. Use very broad matte planes and a few large teeth and beveled edges, with no additional padlock, checkmark, shield, card slot, lettering or ornamental marks.
Style: match Image 2's broad sculpted polygonal planes, warm matte highlights, strong nearly-black clean outer contour, thick simplified internal separations, weighty toy-like sci-fi construction, very restrained surface detail. This is polished hand-painted game art, not a photograph, vector symbol or pixel art. Native 32px clarity is the priority; build a few large masses, not a detailed tiny scene.
Composition: a single centered isolated icon in a SQUARE canvas, complete subject including all components visible, about 84-88% of the canvas extent, with genuine empty transparent safety margin on all four sides. Preserve the main reference orientation. Nothing may touch or be clipped by the canvas edge.
Transparency and finish: actual transparent RGBA background, every non-subject pixel fully transparent. Near-opaque object planes. Clean antialiasing only on object edges. No background color, gradient, checkerboard, ground, floor, cast shadow, drop shadow, bloom, glow outside the subject, atmospheric haze, soft shadow cloud, vignette, lettering, border panel, watermark or signature. The outermost canvas perimeter must be fully transparent. All colored accents stay on the subject. Create only this ONE icon, not a board or multiple variants.
